additional_info.subject: RE: ID0454204-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2 / S4 313676283001] Vendor error secc pilot is E CRM:03056000113
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Haupt,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0454204.
The ticket was opened for Vendor code "secc pilot is E" which happened often lately.
I had a look at the charger's behavior over the last 2 weeks, and at the timestamp provided on 07.10.2025, and these are my findings:
The charger experienced a severe event of communication problem on 07.10.2025, which resulted in unavailability of the outlets and several messages "secc pilot is E" on 07.10.2025.
The charger on 07.10.2025 was running on FW v7.0.5, which includes the FW version v1.4.5 of SECC
Since 10.10.2025, the charger has been updated to v8.0.5. This FW version includes a new SECC FW version, v1.4.11, which solves most of the communication issues related to SECC and outlet unavailability.
Since 10.10.2025, no further error message "secc pilot is E" was communicated.
I would assume that the charger experienced by time to time unavailability of the outlets due to internal error processing, and since the FW update to the latest version this behavior disappeared.
If you agree, I would proceed to close this ticket, as the issue is solved. If you experience further unjustified Vendor error codes, or random unavailability of the outlets, I kindly ask you to open a new service request, and we will investigate on the new symptoms/timestamps.
Thank you and wish you a great weekend!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
